text:
Status
April 1, 1964
FHWA rejects State of Wisconsin's request for access to I-94 with General Mitchell Field.
September 19, 1967
FHWA granted access to I-94 and approved an interchange near Grange Avenue to exclusively service the airport.
September, 1967
U.S. Department of Transportation requesting nationwide improvement of access to major airports.
November 28, 1967
State of Wisconsin adds Airport Spur to the State Trunk Highway System.
January 31, 1968
FHWA rejects Interstate designation for Airport Spur connection.
February 29, 1968
FHWA approves addition to the Federal Aid Primary System connecting General Mitchell Field with Interstate Route I-94.
January 21, 1969
Milwaukee County Board adopted Master Plan for expansion of General Mitchell Field's passenger and air cargo facilities.
March 11, 1969
Milwaukee County Board officially adds Airport Spur to County Expressway System.
March 25, 1969
Corridor Location Public Hearing held for Airport Spur.
August 13, 1969
FHWA approved Corridor #5 for location of Airport Spur Freeway.
September 5, 1969
FHWA approved Relocation Program Plan as submitted by the Division of Highways.
September, 1969
Wisconsin Department of Transportation published in several locations a notice of opportunity to hold a design public hearing.
October 31, 1969
FHWA declares that a Design Public Hearing would not be required since no requests to hold one were made by interested persons; all other federal requirements of PPM 20-8 were fulfilled.
January 1, 1970
Enactment of National Environmental Policy Act.
November 13, 1970
FHWA granted design approval for Airport Spur, met requirements of PPM 20-8 and obviated EIS requirement.
